Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry experiment described in the 'BAG3 interactome proteomic analysis' section is a discovery-based affinity purification (AP-MS) to identify interactors of BAG3. While the broader paper performs differential experiments (siRNA depletion of STK38, overexpression, etc.), those are validated via immunoblotting and qPCR, not by the MS dataset (PXD014473). The MS experiment itself does not have a differential perturbation axis; it is a characterization of the BAG3 complex in a single stable cell line.
